title: Chestnut Cardamom Barfi Diamonds
tagline: Soft, fragrant winter fudge for anyone who owns a sweet tooth and a diya.
steps: Lightly grease an 18cm square tin with the sunflower oil and line it with baking parchment, leaving an overhang so you can lift the barfi out later.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over a medium heat. Add the chestnut purée and mash it with a wooden spoon until smooth and glossy.
Stir in the sugar and milk. Cook gently for 8 minutes, stirring often, until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture thickens and spits slightly.
Reduce the heat to low. Add the milk powder, cardamom and salt. Stir constantly for 5 minutes until the mixture is thick and pulls away from the sides.
Take off the heat and stir in the rose water and half the pistachios. Press firmly into the tin with the back of a spoon, then scatter over the remaining pistachios and press them in.
Cool for 15 minutes, then chill for 45 minutes until firm. Lift out and cut into 16 diamonds with a sharp, oiled knife. Keep in the fridge.
image_prompt: Neat diamond-shaped pieces of pale golden-brown chestnut barfi stacked in overlapping rows on a brass plate, each topped with finely chopped bright green pistachios, a few dried rose petals scattered, cardamom pods beside, soft glowing warm light.
alt_text: Diamond-shaped chestnut barfi sprinkled with green pistachios and rose petals, arranged on a brass plate with cardamom pods.
caption_hook:
Chestnuts are everywhere right now, so we've given them the barfi treatment. Cardamom, rose, pistachio, no faff.

Who's making the sweets in your house this Diwali?
